# 1. Import data and codebook

```{r import-data}
# ============================================================
# FILE PATHS — UPDATE THESE BEFORE RUNNING ON THE REAL DATA
# ============================================================
#
# The paths below are relative to Sofia's Dissertation-Aim-1
# project folder. When running this file on another computer,
# replace BOTH paths below with the locations of:
#   1. the real registry dataset
#   2. the master codebook
#
# These may be relative paths (recommended if using an R project)
# or full local paths on your computer.

# ---- UPDATE PATH 1: DATASET ----
data_file <- "data/raw/synthetic_data.csv"

# ---- UPDATE PATH 2: MASTER CODEBOOK ----
codebook_file <- "Dissertation_Aim1_Master_Codebook.xlsx"


# ============================================================
# IMPORT DATA AND CODEBOOK — NO PATH CHANGES NEEDED BELOW HERE
# ============================================================

dat <- read_csv(data_file)

region_codes  <- read_excel(codebook_file, sheet = "Region Codes")
comuna_codes  <- read_excel(codebook_file, sheet = "Comuna Codes")
closure_codes <- read_excel(codebook_file, sheet = "Closure Codes")
country_codes <- read_excel(codebook_file, sheet = "Country Codes")
```

# 2. Helper functions

```{r helper-functions}
# Clean frequency table for any categorical variable
freq_table <- function(data, variable) {
  data %>%
    count({{ variable }}, name = "n", .drop = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      percent = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1),
      display_value = if_else(
        is.na(as.character({{ variable }})),
        "Missing",
        as.character({{ variable }})
      )
    ) %>%
    select(display_value, n, percent)
}

# Horizontal bar plot for categorical variables
bar_plot <- function(data, variable, title, x_label = NULL) {
  plot_dat <- data %>%
    mutate(
      plot_value = if_else(
        is.na(as.character({{ variable }})),
        "Missing",
        as.character({{ variable }})
      )
    ) %>%
    count(plot_value, name = "n")

  ggplot(plot_dat, aes(x = reorder(plot_value, n), y = n)) +
    geom_col() +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = x_label,
      y = "Number of records"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
}
```

# 4. Age at case creation

```{r age-summary}
age_summary <- tibble(
  Measure = c("Non-missing", "Missing", "Mean", "SD", "Median", "Minimum", "Maximum"),
  Value = c(
    sum(!is.na(dat$edad_ano_creacion_caso)),
    sum(is.na(dat$edad_ano_creacion_caso)),
    mean(dat$edad_ano_creacion_caso, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd(dat$edad_ano_creacion_caso, na.rm = TRUE),
    median(dat$edad_ano_creacion_caso, na.rm = TRUE),
    min(dat$edad_ano_creacion_caso, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(dat$edad_ano_creacion_caso, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)

kable(age_summary, digits = 1)
```

```{r age-histogram}
ggplot(dat, aes(x = edad_ano_creacion_caso)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, boundary = 0) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Age at Case Creation",
    x = "Age (years)",
    y = "Number of records"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# 6. Geography

## Region of residence

```{r region}
region_display <- dat %>%
  left_join(
    region_codes,
    by = c("cmd_cod_deis_regi_benef" = "Region Code")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    region_label = case_when(
      is.na(cmd_cod_deis_regi_benef) ~ "Missing",
      is.na(`Region name`) ~ paste0(
        "Unmapped code: ", cmd_cod_deis_regi_benef
      ),
      TRUE ~ `Region name`
    )
  )

region_summary <- region_display %>%
  count(region_label, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(percent = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

kable(region_summary,
      col.names = c("Region", "n", "%"))

ggplot(region_summary, aes(x = reorder(region_label, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Records by Region",
    x = "Region",
    y = "Number of records"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Comuna of residence

```{r comuna}
comuna_display <- dat %>%
  left_join(
    comuna_codes,
    by = c("comuna" = "Comuna Code")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    comuna_label = case_when(
      is.na(comuna) ~ "Missing",
      is.na(Comuna) ~ paste0("Unmapped code: ", comuna),
      TRUE ~ Comuna
    )
  )

comuna_summary <- comuna_display %>%
  count(comuna, comuna_label, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(percent = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

cat("Number of unique non-missing comuna codes:",
    n_distinct(dat$comuna, na.rm = TRUE), "\n\n")

kable(comuna_summary,
      col.names = c("Comuna code", "Comuna", "n", "%"))
```

*No comuna bar plot is shown because there are many comuna categories; the complete frequency table is more interpretable.*

## IPD confirmed × discarded cross-tab

This cross-tab is a QC check to show how the two IPD status variables occur together. It does not define the analytic sample or recode either variable.

```{r ipd-cross-tab}
ipd_cross_tab <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    ipd_confirmed_display = if_else(
      is.na(ipd_cofirmado), "Missing", ipd_cofirmado
    ),
    ipd_discarded_display = if_else(
      is.na(ipd_descartado), "Missing", ipd_descartado
    )
  ) %>%
  count(ipd_confirmed_display, ipd_discarded_display, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(percent = round(100 * n / nrow(dat), 1)) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

kable(
  ipd_cross_tab,
  col.names = c("IPD confirmed", "IPD discarded", "n", "% of all records")
)
```

# 10. Date and calendar year

```{r date-year}
fecha_creacion_date <- readr::parse_date(
  dat$fecha_creacion_caso,
  format = "%d%b%Y",
  locale = readr::locale("en")
)

ano_creacion <- lubridate::year(fecha_creacion_date)

date_summary <- tibble(
  Measure = c(
    "Missing original dates",
    "Dates missing after parsing",
    "Non-missing dates that failed to parse",
    "Earliest date",
    "Latest date",
    "Earliest year",
    "Latest year"
  ),
  Value = c(
    as.character(sum(is.na(dat$fecha_creacion_caso))),
    as.character(sum(is.na(fecha_creacion_date))),
    as.character(sum(!is.na(dat$fecha_creacion_caso) &
                       is.na(fecha_creacion_date))),
    as.character(min(fecha_creacion_date, na.rm = TRUE)),
    as.character(max(fecha_creacion_date, na.rm = TRUE)),
    as.character(min(ano_creacion, na.rm = TRUE)),
    as.character(max(ano_creacion, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
)

kable(date_summary)
```

```{r year-summary-plot}
year_summary <- tibble(year = ano_creacion) %>%
  filter(!is.na(year)) %>%
  count(year, name = "n")

kable(year_summary,
      col.names = c("Calendar year", "n"))

ggplot(year_summary, aes(x = year, y = n)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(
    min(year_summary$year),
    max(year_summary$year),
    by = 2
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Records by Calendar Year",
    x = "Calendar year",
    y = "Number of records"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# 11. QC flags for planned Aim 1 population

These checks identify records requiring review. They do not remove or alter any observations.

```{r qc-flags}
qc_summary <- tibble(
  Check = c(
    "Age <15 years",
    "Age >65 years",
    "Year before 2005",
    "Year after 2023",
    "Missing age",
    "Missing case creation date",
    "Unmapped region code",
    "Unmapped country code"
  ),
  n = c(
    sum(dat$edad_ano_creacion_caso < 15, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(dat$edad_ano_creacion_caso > 65, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(ano_creacion < 2005, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(ano_creacion > 2023, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(is.na(dat$edad_ano_creacion_caso)),
    sum(is.na(dat$fecha_creacion_caso)),
    sum(
      !is.na(dat$cmd_cod_deis_regi_benef) &
      is.na(region_display$`Region name`)
    ),
    sum(
      !is.na(dat$cmd_cod_pais_origen) &
      is.na(country_display$`Country Name`)
    )
  )
)

kable(qc_summary)
```

# 12. Missingness summary

```{r missingness}
missing_summary <- tibble(
  Variable = names(dat),
  Missing_n = map_int(dat, ~sum(is.na(.x))),
  Missing_percent = round(
    100 * map_int(dat, ~sum(is.na(.x))) / nrow(dat),
    1
  )
) %>%
  arrange(desc(Missing_percent))

kable(missing_summary,
      col.names = c("Variable", "Missing n", "Missing %"))
```
